svg.title: Dango native vector · maximum two-eye three-quarter
svg.desc: Bounded front/maximum two-eye three-quarter prototype grounded in the exact original dango-design-reference-v2.png. Preserves body attachments and expression identifiers while restoring a compact softly angular silhouette, short integrated ears, a single lower notch and restrained dot eyes. Back remains the prior artwork pending visual review.
